# Rule: Strong export loss stays breaking under a binding rule

_Canonical rule slug:_ `export-loss-strong-binding-stays-breaking`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A GLOBAL export is withdrawn alongside WEAK losses, and a binding-scoped weak reclassify rule must not demote it, so the run stays breaking.

## Canonical demonstration

- [case218_export_loss_strong_binding_stays_breaking](../case218_export_loss_strong_binding_stays_breaking.md) — a GLOBAL export loss stays BREAKING under a `binding: weak` rule (🔴 BREAKING)
